proof_summary: Split by parity, rewrite the Gamma factors using factorial and double-factorial identities, and decompose each factorial into a balanced power of \(p\), an earlier factorial, and full or half blocks of residues prime to \(p\). Full shifted blocks are unchanged modulo \(p^{3r}\) by a degree-two product expansion and reciprocal-sum vanishing (the linear sum modulo \(p^{2r}\), the pair sum modulo \(p^r\)); in the odd case a prime-power Lehmer–Morley half-block identity supplies the compensating powers of \(4\), after which the remaining unit factors cancel.
